queries.result: First-party discovery identified Ethiopia's official Addis e-Land cadastral portal and Ethio-NSDI national spatial-data portal. Results did not identify a Bonsa Bota local registry, cadastral viewer, or parcel API. The e-Land service is presented as an Addis Ababa cadastral service.
